info.about: Mister Mosquito, spelled Mr Moskeeto in PAL regions and known in Japan as Ka , is a stealth video game developed by Zoom and published by Sony Computer Entertainment for the PlayStation 2.
info.trivia: The goal is to drink enough of the Yamada family's blood over one summer for the mosquito to hibernate through autumn and winter.
info.why: Eidos published it in North America under its Fresh Games label, and the disc was the only way to play it until the September 2024 PS4 and PS5 re-release.
